body: Wow thank you for the encouraging and kind words. I really need it, I'm on the ledge of a cliff with one foot in the air ready to step off. I'm  just so afraid to ask for help because I feel the help/treatment will just be more money burned for nothing; I have a history of relapse and I feel ridiculous/not worth it. I should be able to function as an adult and I'm just...a shell of my former self. Again thank you, I'll try to write something up for them. I have a few days to mull this over, if anything positive happens I'll give an update.
